function.name: RtlFindMostSignificantBit
function.header_comment:
/*************************************************************************
 * RtlFindMostSignificantBit	[NTDLL.@]
 *
 * Find the most significant bit in a 64 bit integer.
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  The position of the most significant bit.
 */
